brief: JPM Market Intelligence stays Tactically Cautious / Neutral into Friday's CPI, Monetization Menu unchanged week on week. The chain: Friday's NFP was a monster print, which supports US growth staying above trend into YE26 and lowers the CPI bar needed for a Fed hike, so OIS prices a 63% chance of a 25bp hike on Sep 16 and CPI becomes the deciding event. JPM ECON reads Waller as setting Core PCE of 0.30% MoM, 2.8% YoY as the hike bar. The desk expects 1-2 hikes, endurable for equities, versus an elongated cycle that would end the bull market, so it waits for CPI before getting long. The menu is long NDX versus short RTY, Mag7 over SMID caps, large-cap banks, with short credit ETFs and long VIX as hedges. Separately, US and Iran attacks took Brent to $100 for the first time since July 24. Positioning Intel keeps US TPM at the 40th percentile but flags hedge fund re-grossing on 4 of the past 5 days, a +1.3z weekly rise and the highest since late June.
